candidates.reason: This is the direct unit test for ScrapyJSONEncoder. Its datetime.datetime, datetime.date, and datetime.time cases currently expect the space-separated datetime string '2010-01-02 10:11:12', so it is the primary test that must be updated and run to verify ISO 8601 serialization.

The JSON exporter tests include a datetime value in their shared non-string-types fixture and compare exported output after converting it with str(), which produces the old space-separated representation. These tests exercise both JsonItemExporter and JsonLinesItemExporter, which delegate datetime encoding to ScrapyJSONEncoder.
